name: isRulestackCommitClean
definition: True when no rulestack that a managed firewall uses has uncommitted candidate changes, so the policy the firewall enforces equals the last committed configuration.
population: rulestacks used by the managed firewalls; rulestacks no firewall uses are ignored; denominator = every firewall read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every firewall (the firewall list and the per-firewall reads agree) and of the rulestack list, with the list carrying its uncommitted array, covering every local and global rulestack a firewall uses, and none of the used rulestacks in the uncommitted array.
citations: Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS, pan.dev openapi-specs/cloudngfw/aws (ManageNGFW, ManageRulestacks, ManageCertificateObjects), rendered at https://pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/

changeLog.change: Registered so the Cloud NGFW transform can emit it. Meaning written from the public reference only; no customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Answers only a tool that has a commit step between candidate and running policy. Whether other firewall tools should answer this key is not ruled.
